title: Andy comes back after making a card
note: Andy's own exchange, M21 (2026-11-02): 'Oh, hello, Andrew. It's good to see you again. I was just thinking about the card we just made...' and 'That is something that you would say to a three-year-old.' The opener test, with the card in her memory.

memory.name: Andrew
facts: Made a birthday card for a friend last week and signed his name to it.

recent.text: Let's make a birthday card for my buddy.
All right. What do you want it to say?
Just put happy birthday, and sign it from me.

turns: Not much. Just got back from dinner. It was cold again.
Yeah, same as every night. What's going on with you?
You ever get tired of being stuck on a laptop?
I've been working on this app most of the day.
It's coming along. Got a lot left to do.
What do you think makes somebody worth talking to?
See, I don't need anybody telling me I did a good job for signing a card.
Good. Just talk to me like a regular person.
You know anything about old Ford trucks?
My dad had a '72 F-100. Three on the tree.
